disagreements.text: Three of us ran the same session on the same day, different shoes, within 10 seconds of each other over 5 miles. I'm not saying shoes do nothing, but whatever they do was smaller than the noise between three people.
The club needs to stop pretending the Tuesday session is for everyone. It isn't and it never has been.
Times are down about 3% since the shoe rules changed, so obviously the shoes are the whole story and the sport has a problem.
